context.description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。

notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

context.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
context.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

context.description_zh: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。

evidence: 敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

context.description_en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。

subject: magnataur_reverse_polarity

evidence: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。
Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

context.description_en: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。

subject: mars_spear
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。

context.description_en: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
context.description_zh: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
notes_en: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
notes_zh: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。

shard_loc.en: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

subject: meteor_hammer
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.

abilities.title: Meteor Hammer
abilities.description:
CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for 6 seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for 20% for the duration of the burn. 

Building Impact Damage: 90 
Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Non-Building Impact Damage: 130 
Non-Building Over Time Damage: 50 

Channel Duration: 2 seconds.
Landing Time: 0.5 seconds.

subject: mirana_arrow
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。
The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target.
目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。
神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.
Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes.
For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.

context.description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
context.description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
notes_en: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter_loc.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

subject: monkey_king_boundless_strike
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。
Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack.

context.description_en: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。

shard_loc.en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.
shard_loc.zh: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

subject: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.
Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength.
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。
If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。

context.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
context.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
notes_en: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。

subject: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。
眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。
Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing.
Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

context.description_en: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
context.description_zh: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
notes_en: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.
notes_zh: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

subject: nyx_assassin_burrow
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased.
钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。

context.description_en: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
context.description_zh: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
notes_en: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.
notes_zh: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。

subject: nyx_assassin_impale
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.

context.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
context.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%，最远作用距离为%length%。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。

subject: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage.
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。
钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.

context.description_en:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
context.description_zh:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
notes_en: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: pangolier_gyroshell
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。
敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land.
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。

context.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

subject: pangolier_rollup
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。
If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

context.description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
context.description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。

subject: primal_beast_onslaught
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。
Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact.

context.description_en:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
context.description_zh:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。

subject: primal_beast_rock_throw
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies.

context.description_en: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location. Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
context.description_zh: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

subject: rattletrap_battery_assault
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。

context.description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
context.description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
notes_en: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

subject: sandking_burrowstrike
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces.
沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。

context.description_en: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
context.description_zh: 沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。

context.description_en: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
context.description_zh: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。

subject: slardar_slithereen_crush
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.
猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。
After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

context.description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
context.description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。

shard_loc.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
shard_loc.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

subject: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。

context.description_en: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.
notes_zh: 饼干的弹道速度为%projectile_speed%。

shard_loc.en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard_loc.zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

subject: snapfire_spit_creep
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area.
小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。

context.description_en: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
context.description_zh: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。

subject: sniper_assassinate
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

context.description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
context.description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
notes_en: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

subject: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。
Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack.

context.description_en: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
context.description_zh: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。

scepter_loc.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
scepter_loc.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。

subject: tidehunter_ravage
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。

context.description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
context.description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
notes_en: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.
notes_zh: 毁灭能伤害隐身单位。
毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。

subject: tiny_avalanche
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。

context.description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
context.description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。

subject: tusk_snowball
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和眩晕时间都会得到提升。
Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage.
发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被眩晕并受到伤害。

context.description_en: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
context.description_zh: 巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被眩晕并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和眩晕时间都会得到提升。
notes_en: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.
notes_zh: 雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。

subject: tusk_walrus_kick
definition: 使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
evidence: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them.
将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成眩晕，伤害和减速。

context.description_en: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.
context.description_zh: 将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成眩晕，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域%search_radius%范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少%creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
